categories.label: Eziologia
categories.question: Why and through which conditions or mechanisms does criminal participation in the legal economy develop?

categories.label: Diagnosi
categories.question: Which observed characteristics describe or recognise criminal presence or influence?

categories.label: Screening
categories.question: How can a procedure identify potential cases not yet recognised?

categories.label: Terapia
categories.question: How can criminal relationships be disrupted and affected economic activities recovered?

categories.label: Prognosi
categories.question: What subsequent development, recoverability or recurrence can be expected after identification?

categories.label: Prevenzione
categories.question: How can vulnerability to criminal entry be reduced?

rules: Code the main substantive contribution, not isolated vocabulary or generic policy implications.
One primary category; secondary categories require separate substantive evidence.
Prediction alone does not establish prognosis.
Review selection screening is different from screening as a scientific contribution.
Use insufficient_evidence when available sources do not support classification; outside_framework is different.
All machine outputs remain proposals; no eligibility, inclusion, publication or curator coding is overwritten.
Do not infer numerical confidence without empirical calibration.
source_basis: Owner discussion of 11 September 2026; operational adaptation of the Cincimino framework, not a verbatim reproduction.
